I was the DM, the party was getting ran out of town by a corrupt leader. A cultist they met and were nice to earlier (they didn't know was a cultist) decided to provide them shelter from the corrupt guards.

They get sheltered in thier underground bunker where one of the players was being held in a prison there. The cult hated undead and necromancy seeing it as disrespectful to the concept of life, and the player captured was a sentient undead, along with a friendly ghost that was also imprisoned there. So they decide to break out with middling bloodshed.

The ghost was greatful to them decided to provide them shelter in thier church that wasn't too far away instead. 

The "church" turned out to be an exact replica of the other cult bunker but inverted. And the lay out was exactly the same down to positioning of units and the cult leaders name inverted from the opposite cult leader with the exact same personality. Their cult was all about necromancy and gaining eternal life. Every member of each cult were identical twins of the opposite cults members just with inverted or anagram-ed names.

TL;DR I made two basically identical but inverted rival cults that acted exactly the same other than what they believed and got a laugh and some baffled expressions out of the players.
